title: Find why finished PRs slipped past every session's tracking, then fix the cause
why: Owner, 12:17 and 12:22 CST Nov 7: PRs slipped everyone's radar although they were part of triage, status, plans, goals and handoffs, so the tracking itself failed mechanically. He offered an Opus lane to brainstorm first. Outcome at stake: a reviewed change that never reaches main is a rule that never governs. Example: the owner's 12:09 complaint (answered items stay on the page) is what #1383 fixes, and #1383 has sat unmerged since 01:44 CST.
note: Measured 12:28 CST Nov 7: 68 open claude-settings PRs (66 drafts) and 25 open q_max PRs; ancestry test against origin/main: none of the 68 has landed. Oldest: claude-settings #919 (Nov 1), q_max #700 (Oct 11); q_max non-draft batch PRs #1011 (Nov 2) and #1038 (Nov 6) and dependabot bumps #884 (Oct 14) and #1013 sit open. One known cause: item 330 b held the claude-settings merge queue from about 05:00 CST Nov 7. Triage's own part: its handoff kept an on-merge list of 8 PRs and reported them each wake as 'none merged yet' under Next, a stall shown as routine; the list had no age limit and no owner, so a stalled PR looked like one in progress. Lane: Opus, brainstorm first (owner's offer). Read the trackers (handoffs, roadmap steps, page items, runner queues, lane reports) and name where each untracked PR fell out. Then propose one mechanism whose done check is an outcome: the longest wait from passed review to merge, and the count of open PRs with no next act, each with gold 0. Feeds step pr-state-is-on-the-pr. Found by triage 12:34 CST: decision stalled-steps (docs/decisions/stalled-steps.md, line 10) counts 'an open PR on branch <id>' as a live lane. So a step whose PR sits idle is never a stalled step, and the roadmap build, the page's stalled band and triage all read it as in progress. An open PR is not progress; the test must be age since the PR's last act (review, push, batch). Also: step triage-stale-ready-report (done Nov 2, PR #1082) promised each triage report lists draft PRs older than 12 hours with no live lane; with the open-PR rule above, that list can never name one. Opus lane started 12:42 CST Nov 7.
